data.name: 追逃 Chase&Escape
data.detailed_description:
Game Background

After finishing his night shift, construction worker Chen Lin is suddenly confronted with a series of bizarre events: his girlfriend Jiayi goes missing, strange dolls appear, and he finds himself inexplicably chased by Jiayi herself. What lies behind these eerie occurrences?

Gameplay

When faced with threats, fear arises from a lack of power—unfortunately, this game doesn’t provide weapons. The psychological terror heightens your adrenaline. Unarmed and vulnerable, listen carefully—footsteps are approaching! Rely on your sharp observation skills to evade the unknown pursuer. When cornered, conserve your energy and find a way to escape. During the relentless cycle of fleeing, don’t forget to thoroughly examine items, explore your surroundings for clues, and gather essential tools. Piece together the puzzles and uncover the full story behind the mystery!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1080 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
